value.rationale: The predator invasion multiplier is neutral at b=d, so first-order stability analysis cannot determine whether extinction is global or whether its rate is algebraic. Proving universal predator recovery 1/t, the induced prey deficit and the parameter-dependent signed logarithmic correction answers a natural and measurable dynamical question. The positive-parameter cancellation surface separates distinct asymptotic clocks and is not an arbitrary parameter slice.
